scale_proposal.verification: Resized hardalpha의 실제 opaque rectangle이 desiredW/H를 포함하는지 다시 검사하고 actual placement에서 모든 protected alpha1를 확인. Core centre로 cover9offset, unchangedq-relative sham25offset.

issue2_KO: V1은 이미 wholecutout bbox가 native frame 및 원 RGB96 sample-centre envelope 안에 완전히 들어가야 하므로 sham 대부분이 crop밖인 경우는 거부한다. 그러나 equalnativearea와 no-clipping만으로 RGB96에서의 편집 노출량이 같다고 할 수 없다. 동일한 1px shape를1nativepx 옮긴 생성 반례에서 두 shape 모두 crop안이고 area80으로 같지만, 실제96sampling phase의 bilinear alpha mass는0과40이었다.

mass_proposal.native_frame: Globalalpha cell count cover==sham>0; both unclipped.
mass_proposal.native_in_original_crop: Within original RGB96 sample-centre envelope, visible nativealpha cell count==globalalpha cell count for BOTH; no partially outside sham.
mass_proposal.actual_RGB96_operator: Same q+((j+.5)/96-.5)*L and bilinear/zero/RGBvalid rule, applied to alpha as float64 without uint8 quantization. This is GT-side footprint accounting, never a model input or soft semantic mask.
mass_proposal.criterion: Both96masses>0 AND abs(Mcover-Msham) <= 1e-9 + .01*(Mcover+Msham)/2. The1e-9 term is numeric only; there is no2-pixel allowance that could dominate tiny footprints.
mass_proposal.finite_pair_rule: First SHA-ranked feasible pair in fixed9cover x25sham candidates satisfying FULLcover/CLEARsham and mass. None=>bothafterU; no rescale/donor replacement/querymove/favorable row drop.
mass_proposal.counts_required: Record global/nativecrop/96masses, discrepancy, allowed tolerance, rejectedpair count/reason and all original rows. Geometry coverage and mass rejection are distinct.
